faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What kind of photo should I upload?
faq.a1: A clear front-facing portrait works best. Good lighting and a plain background will give the best results.
faq.q2: How many avatars can I generate?
faq.a2: It depends on your license. Starter gives you 50 renders per month, Essential 150, Pro Studio 500, and Business 2,000.
faq.a3: Yes. All payments are processed through secure, PCI-compliant payment gateways. We never store your card details.
faq.q4: Can I use my avatars commercially?
faq.a4: Pro Studio and Business licenses include commercial use rights.
faq.q5: What happens when I reach my monthly limit?
faq.a5: Your render counter resets every 30 days from your purchase date. You can upgrade your plan at any time.
